reviews.thesis: 38,000 structural level held on the first pullback after the October breakout; 10/7 closed near the session low, so acceptance still needs confirmation.
reviews.confirmation: Close acceptance above 38,000 followed by recovery of 39,600-40,400
reviews.chaseJudgement: Extended movement above 40,400 without a retest is structurally late.
reviews.counterargument: 10/7 low-location close after 10/6 expansion leaves failed-breakout risk.

reviews.thesis: Rising medium-term structure remains intact, but repeated rejection around 161,200-164,700 leaves price directly below established supply.
reviews.confirmation: Close acceptance above 164,700 or a successful retest of 149,800-155,400
reviews.chaseJudgement: Current supply-zone extension has poor asymmetry.
reviews.counterargument: The structural invalidation remains wide and the prior-high zone is unresolved.

reviews.thesis: The late-September expansion is testing 78,100, a prior event-close/role-reversal level near the 120-day average; 10/7 showed upper rejection.
reviews.confirmation: Hold 78,100 and recover 82,500; stronger confirmation above 84,800
reviews.chaseJudgement: A rebound away from 78,100 without retest has higher extension risk.
reviews.counterargument: Recent RSI/volume expansion and the 10/7 rejection increase pullback risk.

reviews.thesis: Price is oscillating between the 1,098,000 trend-bridge support and repeated 1.20m supply; 10/7 again rejected the upper area.
reviews.confirmation: Close acceptance above 1,200,000 or a confirmed reversal near 1,098,000
reviews.chaseJudgement: The middle-to-upper part of the range is not a clean structural location.
reviews.counterargument: MA120 remains overhead and repeated 1.20m failures show unresolved supply.

reviews.thesis: The 256,000-293,000 September box has broken upward, but two-session expansion leaves the 10/7 close materially extended from 293,000.
reviews.confirmation: Successful 293,000 retest followed by renewed acceptance above 306,500
reviews.chaseJudgement: The current extension above the former box is late relative to the structural level.
reviews.counterargument: RSI returned above 70 and 320,000 intraday supply appeared on 10/7.

reviews.thesis: The 164,700 prior-high area has been reclaimed within an aligned medium-term trend; 10/7 made a fresh 173,700 test but did not fully clear it.
reviews.chaseJudgement: A one-session spike through 173,700 without close acceptance is insufficient.
reviews.counterargument: The 170,000 area has produced prior rejection and current ATR is elevated.

reviews.thesis: The 36,412 role-reversal level remains intact after a low-volume 10/7 pullback; the close at 36,800 is close enough for a clean structural test.
reviews.chaseJudgement: Movement far above 38,800 without support confirmation is extended.
reviews.counterargument: MA20 has been lost and a break of 36,000 opens materially lower support.

reviews.thesis: Price advanced from the mid-12,000s to about 20,000 in a short window with sustained volume expansion; it is now far from the original 18,100 structure.
reviews.confirmation: Retest acceptance in 18,100-19,450 followed by recovery of 20,800
reviews.chaseJudgement: Current price remains extended from the decision level.
reviews.counterargument: RSI is above 70 near the 120-day average, increasing mean-reversion risk.

reviews.thesis: The September stair-step advance remains constructive, but 10/7 rejected 336,000 and closed at 310,000 while structural downside remains wide.
reviews.chaseJudgement: The current level is too far from the nearest clean role-reversal reference.
reviews.counterargument: Wide ATR and the 10/7 upper wick weaken current asymmetry.

reviews.thesis: The September advance reclaimed 505,500 and the 10/7 pullback closed just above that role-reversal area after the 10/1 expansion.
reviews.confirmation: Defend 505,500 and recover 526,000; stronger acceptance above 549,000
reviews.chaseJudgement: A rebound materially above 549,000 without retest is extended.
reviews.counterargument: Post-10/1 rebound highs have softened and failure of 505,500 would negate the role reversal.

reviews.thesis: The 330,000-387,000 box has broken upward and 10/7 retained 391,000, but dense resistance begins near 402,625 and compresses structural reward.
reviews.chaseJudgement: The narrow space to overhead density makes extension unattractive.
reviews.counterargument: Resistance from roughly 402,625-420,000 remains dense despite the box breakout.

reviews.thesis: The chart remains range-bound around the 473,734 density center; 10/7 closed at 469,500 on contracting activity without directional confirmation.
reviews.chaseJudgement: Movement into 484k-499k before acceptance would enter established resistance.
reviews.counterargument: MA20 is overhead and the 484k-514k region contains several resistance references.
